environment.hardware: Intel Core i7-4790,16GiB RAM; one CPU worker per isolated engine; GPU unused in this comparison

mathematics.assertion_tested: Compare exact-engine outcomes and elapsed time on three known-solvable synthetic tasks, four fixed-outside real-board regions and the complete five-clue puzzle within explicit budgets.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Finite integer piece IDs, rotation states and edge colors; exact Boolean/integer constraints. Floating point is used only for time/resource accounting.
mathematics.conventions: state=4*zero-based piece+clockwise rotation; row-major cells; edges NESW; gray0; all pieces exactly once; regional tasks constrain only edges touching released cells.
non_claims: Neighborhood infeasibility only covers its fixed outside pieces.
Synthetic cases do not establish full-puzzle performance.
DFS is Python, SAT/CP native; comparison includes implementation and encoding effects.
Concurrent desktop/BOINC load is uncontrolled; timings are exploratory, not hardware-normalized.
No480/480 solution was found; no fastest full-puzzle engine was established.

randomness.generator: Python random for generated tasks/DFS; SAT initial phases; OR-Tools solver seed

checks: Every solved witness passed independent common-task validation.
Known synthetic witnesses checked before solving.
All24 isolated child runs completed without errors.
Recorded source hashes still matched at manifest creation.
Source tests include exhaustive tiny-puzzle comparisons, cancellation and checkpoint corruption/resume cases.
result: All three engines solved the three synthetic tasks and reported infeasibility for the four specific fixed-outside regional tasks. All three full-puzzle runs timed out after30seconds; whole-puzzle feasibility and fastest algorithm remain inconclusive. DFS was quickest in these small tested tasks.
residual_risks: Desktop and BOINC load were uncontrolled; one run per engine/case.
Python DFS compared with native SAT/CP plus encoding overhead.
Windows memory limit is cooperative; no hard OS memory cap.
No independent UNSAT certificate was checked.
Version1 manual provenance does not enforce all execution input hashes or machine-checkable caps; source/input hashes and budget details are supplied in the artifacts.
